items.title: Flatness and finite presentation of the inertia, and surjectivity of the diagonal, for a gerbe
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a gerbe over a base the inertia is flat and locally of finite presentation, and its diagonal is surjective, flat and locally of finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 6428-6452, label lemma-gerbe-isom-fppf). The proof (source lines 6454-6517) base changes along a smooth presentation of the base, applies the fibre product description of the inertia and the descent statements to reduce to the base-changed gerbe, where the characterization of gerbes by their inertia applies, and then computes the diagonal of a quotient presentation by a flat group space (proof lines 6454-6516). The two reductions and the quotient computation are the substance. H3.
